title: Build Cognitive Ergonomics runtime research and commercial platform
summary: Convert Cognitive Ergonomics from strategy/research register into an executable platform: portfolio register, public assessments, telemetry loop, evidence ledger, research protocols, commercial pilots, and governance gates.

source_basis.core_thesis: AI should adapt to human cognitive profile, biology, timing, emotional state, stress and social context rather than forcing one standard interaction model.

required_build_outputs.name: research_portfolio_registry
required_build_outputs.description: Canonical table for all research ideas, domains, programs, priority tiers, evidence state, commercial path, owner, dependencies, protocol status and next gate.

required_build_outputs.name: assessment_runtime
required_build_outputs.description: Public survey/assessment runtime for AI Sweet Spots, Negative Responders, Cognitive Ergonomics baseline, Prosthetic PFC, Allostatic Load and multi-agent workflow studies.

required_build_outputs.name: telemetry_ledger
required_build_outputs.description: Event model capturing participant consent, interaction context, AI intensity, task type, timestamps, self-report, performance proxy, wellbeing proxy and follow-up drift markers.

required_build_outputs.name: protocol_pack
required_build_outputs.description: One-page protocol template per study with research question, construct map, inclusion/exclusion, consent text, ethics risk, variables, data dictionary and publication/commercial output.

required_build_outputs.name: commercial_widget_layer
required_build_outputs.description: Map research outputs to sellable widgets: enterprise pilot, team calibration, burnout prevention, AI adoption audit, AI intensity profile, longitudinal diagnostics and certification.

required_build_outputs.name: dashboard
required_build_outputs.description: Portfolio and runtime dashboard showing idea stage, evidence state, participant counts, active assessments, data quality, drift signals, commercial readiness and next actions.

execution_sequence: Create Supabase DDL for research.programs, research.ideas, research.protocols, research.assessments, research.telemetry_events, research.participant_consents, research.outputs and research_commercial_map.
Seed the 5 programs and priority themes from the uploaded strategy text.
Create stage-gate state machine: intake, evaluate, design_gate, execute, deliver_integrate, quarterly_review, locked.
Create evidence states: PRETEND, PARTIAL, REAL with REAL requiring live assessment URL, persistence proof, telemetry rows, dashboard visibility, export, and governance receipt.
Build public assessment scaffold with consent-first flow and assessment slug routing.
Implement event ledger writes for assessment_started, consent_granted, question_answered, assessment_completed, score_generated, followup_due and export_generated.
Build dashboards and CSV exports for research register, protocol gaps, assessment metrics, evidence gaps and commercial widget map.
Run smoke tests inserting seed programs, one Negative Responders protocol, one AI Sweet Spots assessment, telemetry events and evidence rows.
Return bridge receipt, commit SHA, runtime URL if deployed, and evidence classification.

first_priority_jobs.reason: Urgent and high-value; identifies users harmed or disempowered by AI interaction.
Existing public research direction; converts static work into live data capture.
Strong health, workforce and commercial relevance.
Revenue bridge into professional services and workplace optimisation.

acceptance_tests: DDL applies cleanly and is idempotent.
Seed data creates five programs and priority themes without duplicates.
Assessment can be started, completed and scored with consent captured.
Telemetry rows are written for each lifecycle event.
Evidence register contains proof rows linked to assessment and protocol IDs.
Dashboard reads from canonical tables only.
CSV exports generate for register, evidence gaps and commercial map.
No item is classified REAL unless runtime URL, persistence, telemetry and receipt exist.
